title: DocVerdict
description: PDF, photo, email, and file comparison evidence checks with plain-language reports.
summary: PDF, photo, email, and file comparison evidence checks with plain-language reports.
offersHint: PDF, photo, email, and file comparison evidence checks with plain-language reports. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.docverdict.com/api/mcp · Optional headers: Authorization

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer API key. Self-serve at https://docverdict.com/api-access. Optional: a keyless trial allows 3 calls per day per IP.

headerDocs.name: Authorization
headerDocs.description: Bearer API key. Self-serve at https://docverdict.com/api-access. Optional: a keyless trial allows 3 calls per day per IP.

toolsPreview.name: verify_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Check one PDF: digital signature status, whether content was added after signing, and metadata observations (creation dates, producing software, edit history). Returns findings JSON and a plain-language report. The result classifies evidence; it never determines fraud, authenticity, or legal validity.

toolsPreview.name: verify_photo
toolsPreview.description: Check one photo (JPG, PNG, or HEIC): camera metadata, capture time, edit traces, and timestamp consistency. Observations suggest, never prove, how the image was made and handled.

toolsPreview.name: verify_email
toolsPreview.description: Check one email saved as .eml: sender alignment, authentication results as recorded by the receiving server, and the delivery route. Classifications only — a mismatch is evidence to weigh, not a conclusion.

toolsPreview.name: compare_pdfs
toolsPreview.description: Compare two PDFs: byte identity, whether one file derives from the other, and what changed (pages, metadata, signature events). Reports the relationship the bytes show; it does not decide which file is the right one.
